summary: @onereach/types-contacts-api ships preinstall dropper that executes obfuscated bundled payload via downloaded Bun runtime
details: The package is published as TypeScript type definitions for a Contacts API but declares scripts.preinstall: node setup.mjs. setup.mjs uses obfuscated identifiers (_0xXXXX) and, on install, downloads the Bun runtime from GitHub releases (https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v<ver>/<arch>.zip), makes it executable, and invokes it against math_init.js in the package root. math_init.js is a 727 KB Bun-compiled bundle marked `// @bun @bun-cjs` that is heavily obfuscated with string-array shuffling (WV8StW), a large opaque literal array, a custom base64-like decoder with a scrambled alphabet (hc1jfK9), and `with` statements that defeat standard deobfuscation. The bundled payload's filename and content are unrelated to a TypeScript types package, which would normally ship only.d.ts sources. The alternate-runtime execution path also causes the payload to bypass Node-based static analysis. The install-time execution of an opaque, obfuscated bundle unrelated to the package's declared purpose matches the alternate-runtime-dropper attack shape.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
